values.note: $25 per site, reserved or first-come (the same in recreation.gov's 2026-2028 tables), including two vehicles or one RV; a third vehicle is $10 a night. Firewood sold by the host.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('$25 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV per site is included in the camping fee. $10 fee for a third vehicle.'; last updated January 23, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232093/rates (2026, 2027: STANDARD / RV / TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 25, peak and walk-in) + recreation.gov ('Firewood is sold by the on-site campground host'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('Note: This is a nonelectric campground.') + campsite catalog for 232093 (all sites NONELECTRIC; Water Hookup No, Sewer Hookup No on 14 of 14 RV-equipment sites), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 14 sites plus the host's: 13 for RVs/trailers/tents (spurs 18-45 ft, most 30-40) and one walk-to tent site; two pull-throughs (sites 6 and 15). recreation.gov's description still says the sites suit 'small trailers'.

sites.source: campsite catalog for 232093 (13 STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC + 1 WALK TO, 004 MANAGEMENT; Max Vehicle Length 18-45, site 002 45 ft; Pull-Through on 006 and 015) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232093 ('Campsites can accommodate small trailers; tent pads are provided') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('Reservations for 10 of the 15 sites'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Accessible double vault toilet; drinking water from a hand pump; bear-proof food lockers at each site and bear-proof trash dumpsters.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('There is a double vault accessible toilet', 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232093 ('accessible vault toilets, drinking water from a hand pump, and bear-proof trash dumpsters', 'Each campsite contains a bear-proof food locker'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: early May to late September, weather dependent; services may be limited early and late. Dates are recreation.gov's 2027 fee seasons (first-come May 7-13, reservable May 14 - Sept 18, first-come Sept 19-25); 2026 opened May 8.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('This campground is open early May to late September, weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232093/rates (2027 First-come 05-07 to 05-13, Peak 05-14 to 09-18, First-come 09-19 to 09-25; 2026 First-come 05-08 to 05-14, Peak 05-15 to 09-19), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 at least four days ahead, for the 2027 peak season May 14 - Sept 18 (2026: May 15 - Sept 19); the weeks either side are first-come. The Forest Service says 10 of the 15 sites are reservable and 5 first-come (the catalog marks 3 not reservable plus the host's); first-come sites must be occupied the same night. Weekends need 2 nights and holiday weekends 3 (not marked soft); walk-ups are exempt. 14 consecutive nights at most.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground ('Reservations for 10 of the 15 sites are required. Five sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.'; 'Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232093 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 4, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (2027 seasons) + availability (May 2027: 'Not Reservable' 05-07 to 05-13, NYR from 05-14), read 2026-10-26

note: Aspen and Douglas-fir campground on the banks of St. Charles Creek, a mile west of Lake Isabel in the Wet Mountains (San Carlos RD, Pike-San Isabel NF); off Hwy 165 via the Lake Isabel Recreation Area's main entrance and Forest Road 374. No cell service. --Claude
summary: FS page (Jan 2026), rec.gov facility, rates, catalog: confirmed $25 (2026-2028), no hookups, 14 sites, 45-ft max. Added two pull-throughs, vault toilet, hand-pump water, season May 7 - Sept 25 (2027 fee seasons), 4-day cutoff, some first-come sites, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 14-night max, booking.season May 14 - Sept 18. Pin is ~145 m from the per-site centroid; creekside fits ('on the banks of St. Charles Creek'). Note: dropped 'Lake Isabel' shorthand (it is a mile from the lake), the count/length restatements and 'Reservable online'.
flags: Entry phone is empty. San Carlos Ranger District 719-269-8500 (FS page; recreation.gov says real-time information is not available and to call that number); recreation.gov gives (719) 489-2034 for facility-specific information.

Aspen Acres Fire: Forest Order 02-12-03-26-43 (Oct 23, 2026 - Dec 31, 2027) does not close the campground, but closes nearby Davenport Campground and restricts the trails from Lake Isabel (St. Charles 1326, East Cisneros 1314, Snowslide 1318/1396, and others) to horse or foot travel, so recreation.gov's ATV/motorcycle trail access from the campground is suspended for that period.
Site count wording differs: the FS page says 10 of 15 sites reservable and 5 first-come; the catalog has 11 reservable (including the walk-to tent site), 3 not reservable and the host site.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/st-charles-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
